files.signature: SearchEngine.rebuild/_performRebuild scans, reads, indexes, and saves in the Electron main process.
smart_search semantic fallback can build an in-memory HNSW index on the query path.
startRebuild and compact schedule same-process async work, not worker isolation.
SQLiteKeywordIndex.rebuild deletes and reinserts all FTS rows in one synchronous transaction.
VACUUM and deleteFiles are synchronous and need WAL/SHM-aware backup handling.
Settings status polling and rebuild/cancel/retry/compact/clear button handlers.

addition_sites.reason: Settings IPC control-plane handlers should keep the same names but delegate heavy work to the worker controller.
Durable job phase/progress/heartbeat/cancel fields can back worker status.
Chunk, embedding, and HNSW maintenance must move to worker or equivalent isolation.
AC-5 requires bounded tokenizer enrichment and metadata/cache behavior.
Worker runtime must load or degrade native HNSW without blocking request paths.
Native rebuild/package smoke scripts need worker-runtime smoke and benchmark entry points.
